The Defective Detective - Album 3: Serah Contemplates

Single and Ready to Mingle

"Single and ready to mingle That’s what her father says"

[Verse] Mixer at seven Banquet at eight

Kell arrives Twenty minutes late

Golden wings Picture in hand

“Are you married?” “Sir, I’m with the band.”

Kell leans closer

“What?”

“I said I’m working.”

“Wonderful family.”

[Pre-Chorus] He cannot hear He cannot see

But somehow love Is crystal clear to Kell

[Chorus] Single and ready to mingle That’s what her father says

Photo in hand at every party Interviewing half the guests

Single and ready to mingle Kala never said a word

Kell’s already planning grandchildren

Kala hasn’t even heard

[Verse] Meanwhile Kala’s home tonight

Screen aglow Room dim light

Fake account Anonymous name

Rikka clips fill every frame

THAT SOLO WAS INSANE

Post

Delete

Rewrite

ABSOLUTE FIRE

Nobody knows

Nobody can

Kala secretly runs Rikka’s biggest fan clan

[Pre-Chorus] President Moderator

First to every show

Kell thinks she needs romance

Kala thinks, “When does Rikka go?”

[Chorus] Single and ready to mingle That’s what her father says

Kala’s busy posting Rikka From an account nobody connects

Single and ready to mingle No, she really isn’t though

Dad is scouting future husbands

She’s ranking Rikka’s best live shows

[Bridge] Kell comes home

“Kala!”

She removes headphones

“What?”

“I met someone wonderful.”

“No.”

“You haven’t heard about him.”

“Still no.”

“He works in finance.”

“No.”

“Or catering.”

“No.”

“I couldn’t quite hear.”

“Dad.”

“Yes?”

“Stop.”

“Of course.”

He will not stop

[Break] Kala’s phone buzzes

RIKKA POSTED

She smiles

Kell sees it

“Who is he?”

“What?”

“You smiled at the phone.”

“No I didn’t.”

“My daughter has a secret admirer!”

Kala closes her eyes

[Final Chorus] Single and ready to mingle Kell has launched another quest

Banquet halls and social mixers Every candidate gets assessed

Single and ready to mingle Kala’s perfectly content

No husband list No dating plan

Just every Rikka post ever sent

[Outro] Kala types:

RIKKA DESERVED A LONGER SET.

Post

Kell squints at the screen

“Is that the young man?”

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“No, Dad.”

“Is he single?”

“GO TO BED.”
